name: autoconf
description: GNU Autoconf, a tool for producing shell scripts that automatically configure software source packages; part of the GNU Autotools build system used by autogen.sh-based projects such as libuv.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
